meta.note: Dining options are NOT included in holiday package budgets. They are shown as nearby suggestions only. Price bands: $ = quick/affordable ($8-18pp), $$ = casual family dining ($18-35pp), $$$ = premium ($35-60+pp). Opening hours may vary — check before visiting.

venues.name: Betty's Burgers Noosa
venues.notes: Cult burger chain on Hastings Street — smashed patties, loaded fries, and the famous concrete frozen custard. Perfect quick lunch between beach sessions.

venues.name: Massimo's Gelateria
venues.notes: Iconic Noosa gelato institution on Hastings Street — Italian-made gelato in incredible flavours. Kids line up here every afternoon. A Noosa holiday essential.

venues.name: Noosa Heads Surf Club
venues.notes: Beachfront surf club with absolute ocean views — steak, parmy, fish & chips, kids' meals ~$12. Unbeatable location, affordable prices, and the sand is metres away.

venues.name: Ricky's River Bar + Restaurant
venues.notes: Upscale waterfront dining on the river — stunning views, seafood, modern Australian cuisine. Special occasion dinner. Kids' menu available for early sittings.

venues.name: Sails Restaurant
venues.notes: Fine dining on Noosa Main Beach — seasonal menu, incredible beachfront views, special occasion destination. Hatted restaurant, bookings essential.

venues.name: Cafe Le Monde
venues.notes: Iconic Noosa Junction cafe — big breakfasts, excellent coffee, burgers, live music some nights. Relaxed, local, family-friendly. Great for breakfast before a beach day.

venues.name: Aromas Noosa
venues.notes: Hastings Street institution — great coffee, all-day breakfast, Modern Australian lunch and dinner. Outdoor seating perfect for people watching. Very family-accepting.

venues.name: The Boathouse Noosa
venues.notes: Stylish waterfront dining on the Noosa River — seafood, share plates, great cocktails. Kids' menu, river views, and a relaxed Noosaville vibe. Bookings recommended.

venues.name: Noosa Marina Waterfront Dining
venues.notes: Casual waterfront restaurants at Noosa Marina — multiple venues with river views, outdoor seating, and a relaxed atmosphere. Good range of cuisines to suit everyone.

venues.name: Bistro C
venues.notes: Beachfront restaurant on Hastings Street — seasonal menu, ocean views, cocktails. Date-night energy but early sittings work for families seeking a special dinner.

venues.name: Sunshine Beach Surf Club
venues.notes: Local surf club on Sunshine Beach — casual beachfront dining, fish & chips, parmy, kids' meals. Less touristy than Noosa Heads but equally good views.

venues.name: Noosaville Fish & Chips
venues.notes: Classic takeaway fish and chips on the Noosa River — grab a family pack and eat on the riverbank or the jetty. Cheap, cheerful, and very Noosa.

venues.name: Pomona Distilling Co (day trip)
venues.notes: Award-winning distillery and restaurant near the Noosa Hinterland — excellent food, craft spirits, beautiful gardens. About 30 min drive from Noosa. Worth the trip.

venues.name: Domino's Pizza Noosa
venues.notes: Cheap pizza for the night you can't be bothered cooking. $5 value pizzas, delivery or pickup. Noosa Junction location.

venues.name: Noosa Chocolate Factory & Ice Creamery
venues.notes: Handmade chocolate and artisan ice cream on the Noosa River — kids go absolutely wild. Free tastings, watch chocolate being made. A holiday treat.
